title: Homelab Infrastructure Shape
description: Declarative shape of a unit of homelab infrastructure provisioned by the C#-native engine / community-scripts renderer. See ADR-0001. kind: Stack groups LXC members and carries a CTID range + inheritable defaults; kind: LXC describes a container with the full Proxmox surface (most fields optional). The community-scripts create path (Deploy-Shape.ps1) honours a subset; the rest is converge-only (ProxmoxSharp, BL-010).

apiVersion.description: Schema version. Bumped when the shape contract changes.

kind.description: What this shape describes. 'Node' is a physical Proxmox host (described, not provisioned). 'Stack' groups LXC/VM members and owns a CTID range + defaults. 'UnifiNetwork' declares UniFi network resources (port-forwards) reconciled by converge-unifi (#221/#102).

name.description: Stable, human-readable identifier (e.g. 'forgejo'). For LXC this drives the hostname unless spec.hostname overrides it.

stack.description: Owning stack (matches a kind: Stack metadata.name, e.g. 'devops'). Omit for hub-owned (non-stack) infra. Member inherits that stack's spec.defaults.

tags.description: Free-form labels (mirrors Proxmox tags). Note: a 'vlan-1010' tag here is UI ceremony only — the real VLAN tag lives in spec.network.vlan.

description.description: Optional human note about this shape.

spec.description: Kind-specific desired state. Constrained per-kind via the allOf branches below (LXC, VM and Stack are strict; Node/NASShare stay permissive until their contracts are tightened).

allOf.description: app + ctid are mandatory for a deployable LXC (ctid omission is an error — no silent allocation). node/os/network may be inherited from the stack, so they are not required on the member itself.
vmid is mandatory for a deployable VM (no silent allocation — mirrors LXC's ctid rule). node may be inherited from the stack, so it is not required on the member itself.

unifiNetworkSpec.description: UniFi network desired-state (#221/#102), reconciled by `converge-unifi` via UnifiSharp's legacy write API. Add-only — converge creates declared resources missing by name and never deletes hand-managed ones.

staticDns.description: Controller-local DNS records (#314/#419) — how a name resolves ON THE LAN, with no public zone involved. Reconciled, not just created: a record that exists but answers differently is corrected. Declared here rather than on a guest shape because the useful ones are zone-level and belong to no single member; a per-client record that rides a DHCP reservation is a different endpoint and lives on the guest as network.reservation.localDnsRecord (#416).

staticDnsRecord.description: A single controller-local DNS record. Matched (for add-only idempotency) by name + type. Wildcards are supported and match arbitrary labels — '*.lab.chrison.dev' answers 'anything.lab.chrison.dev'.

name.description: The name to answer for, e.g. '*.lab.chrison.dev' or 'prometheus.homelab.chrison.internal'.

value.description: The answer — an address for A/AAAA, a target name for CNAME.

ttl.description: Seconds. Omit to leave the controller's default (300) alone — stating it makes converge own it.

portForward.description: A single WAN→LAN port-forward. Matched (for add-only idempotency) by name.

name.description: Unique rule name — the add-only match key.

interface.description: The WAN the rule binds to.

destinationPort.description: WAN port or range. Canonically a string (e.g. '443' or '8080-8090'); a bare integer is also accepted.

forwardPort.description: Forward-to LAN port or range. Canonically a string; a bare integer is also accepted.

source.description: Where the community-scripts ct/<app>.sh is fetched from.

channel.description: stable → community-scripts/ProxmoxVE ; dev → community-scripts/ProxmoxVED (in-development scripts, e.g. forgejo-runner).

repo.description: Explicit 'owner/repo' override. Takes precedence over channel when set (escape hatch).

ref.description: Git ref (branch/tag/commit SHA) to pull the script from. Pin a SHA for reproducibility — dev-channel scripts move.

features.description: Proxmox LXC features (var_* equivalents on the community-scripts path: nesting→var_nesting, fuse→var_fuse).

keyctl.description: Expose keyctl() — needed by some Alpine/systemd workloads.

mount.description: Filesystem types the container may mount itself (e.g. ['nfs','cifs']). See the NFS placement exploration before enabling — in-container NFS is mount-race prone.

up.description: Seconds to wait after start before starting the next.

down.description: Seconds to wait on shutdown before forcing.

tty.description: Number of TTYs available to the container.

networkInterface.description: A single Proxmox netX interface (full surface). Used in spec.networks[]. For an LXC this renders to `name=…,bridge=…,tag=…,type=veth`; for a VM the multi-NIC list is still descriptive only (VmConverger maps the single-NIC `network` sugar).

name.description: Interface name inside the container (e.g. 'eth0' or 'vlan1010').

tag.description: VLAN tag applied on the bridge (the real VLAN — e.g. 1010).

firewall.description: Enable the Proxmox firewall on this interface.

hwaddr.description: MAC address (pin for stable DHCP leases).

dhcpReservation.description: The UniFi DHCP reservation for THIS interface (#416). Declared on the guest because the facts belong to the guest: converge resolves the interface's live MAC after create, then reconciles the reservation against the controller. The UniFi network is resolved from the interface's VLAN tag, so it is never restated here. ADD-ONLY — converge only ever writes a known-client entry whose MAC a shape declares. NOTE on a kind: VM shape this is AUDIT-ONLY — `unifi-reservations` counts it, but the apply path reconciles LXC members only, so a non-parked VM reservation is never written (the audit flags that rather than passing over it). Its intended use on a VM is `parked:`.

fixedIp.description: The reserved address, e.g. '10.10.135.221'. Must sit inside the subnet of the interface's VLAN.

localDnsRecord.description: Per-client local DNS name, e.g. 'shell.devops.chrison.internal' — how the guest resolves from OUTSIDE its own network's domain. Omit for a reservation that only pins an address.

name.description: Operator-facing label on the controller. Defaults to '<member> (CT <ctid>)'.

parked.description: Why this reservation is held for a guest that is deliberately stopped (e.g. 'rollback for the CT 6005 migration, #250'). Present = converge REPORTS the reservation but never writes it, so a parked guest neither drifts nor gets resurrected. Without it, telling a parked reservation from an orphaned one means cross-checking Proxmox by hand — which is how three dead reservations survived unnoticed.

network.description: Primary NIC, homelab-friendly sugar. This is what the community-scripts create path honours (→ var_brg/var_vlan/var_net/var_gateway/var_ipv6_method/var_mtu). For new CTs the renderer emits a single tagged interface name=vlan<vlan>,bridge=<bridge>,tag=<vlan>,ip=<ipv4>.

vlan.description: Real VLAN tag (→ var_vlan, interface tag=).

mount.description: A storage mount (Proxmox mpX). NOTE: the community-scripts create path does NOT provision mounts — these are applied by ProxmoxSharp converge (BL-010). See docs/plans/BL-016-nfs-hardening.md.

type.description: nfs = NAS export, host-level via a Proxmox NFS storage rendered as a storage-backed mpN (gated on storage health) — NEVER mounted inside the guest (BL-016). bind = host path; volume = Proxmox storage volume; device = block device.

storage.description: For type: nfs/volume — the Proxmox storage id (e.g. 'ds1813-nfs-volume-3'). A storage-referenced volume is what lets Proxmox gate CT start on storage availability.

source.description: Volume id, host path, or (for type: nfs) a subpath under the storage's host mount. A raw path bind is NOT storage-gated — prefer a storage volume for app-owned data (BL-016).

size.description: Volume size for type: volume / a newly-allocated nfs volume (e.g. '8G').

shared.description: Marked available on all nodes (does not create it).

device.description: Host device passthrough (Proxmox devX), e.g. a USB serial or /dev/dri for transcoding.

rootfsOptions.description: Extra options for the root volume (size/storage are spec.disk/spec.storage).

lxcRaw.description: Escape hatch: raw lxc.* config lines emitted verbatim (e.g. cgroup device allows, custom mount entries). Use when no first-class field exists.

secret.description: A secret the converge engine resolves at provision time and feeds to the app's post-create step. NEVER inline a secret value — only references/derivation verbs are committed.

secretSource.description: Exactly ONE of: env (pre-existing secret from secrets.env), service (derived from another shape at provision time), or provider (derived from an external API).

env.description: (a) Pre-existing — resolve from the gitignored secrets.env by this env var name (e.g. 'GH_RUNNER_PAT', 'CF_API_TOKEN').

service.description: (b) Derived — mint by invoking an action on another shape in the stack (e.g. Forgejo CLI 'generate-runner-token').

ref.description: Name of the providing shape (should also appear in spec.dependsOn).

provider.description: (c) Derived — mint from an external provider API (e.g. GitHub org runner token, Cloudflare tunnel token).

auth.description: How to authenticate to the provider — typically { env: <PAT name> }.

vmDisk.description: A QEMU disk (Proxmox scsiN/virtioN/sataN). Provisioned by the ProxmoxSharp VM write path (#115).

source.description: Existing volume id to adopt (e.g. 'vm-1003-disk-1'). Omit to allocate a fresh volume of 'size'.

size.description: Disk size in GB (for a freshly-allocated volume).

discard.description: Pass TRIM/discard to the backing store.

vmEfiDisk.description: UEFI vars disk (Proxmox efidisk0) — required when bios is ovmf.

storage.description: Proxmox storage id for the EFI vars volume.

efitype.description: EFI vars size (4m enables Secure Boot key storage).

preEnrolledKeys.description: Ship Microsoft Secure Boot keys pre-enrolled (pre-enrolled-keys=1).

vmTpmState.description: vTPM state disk (Proxmox tpmstate0) — needed for Windows 11 / Secure Boot guests.

storage.description: Proxmox storage id for the TPM state volume.

vmCdrom.description: Install/boot ISO attached to a CD-ROM drive (Proxmox ideN media=cdrom). Detach after install.

iso.description: ISO file name within the storage (e.g. 'bazzite-deck-stable-live.iso').

source.description: Explicit volume id override (e.g. 'local:iso/<name>'). Takes precedence over storage+iso.

hostPci.description: PCI(e) passthrough device (Proxmox hostpciN). The heart of the gaming shape — has no LXC analog. Provide EITHER 'mapping' (a Proxmox PCI resource-mapping name — preferred) OR 'id' (a raw PCI address). Proxmox only lets the real root@pam user set a raw hostpciN ('only root can set hostpciN config for non-mapped devices'); a mapped device is settable by any API token with Mapping.Use and is node-portable. The host's VFIO/IOMMU binding must already be in place (proven on desktop-01 by VM 1002).

mapping.description: Proxmox PCI resource-mapping name (e.g. 'AMD_Radeon_RX6600'). Preferred — token-settable and node-portable. Create the mapping at /cluster/mapping/pci first.

id.description: Raw host PCI address, e.g. '0000:09:00' (function-less = whole device / all functions). root@pam only — prefer 'mapping' for token-driven IaC.

pcie.description: Expose as PCI Express (pcie=1; requires a q35 machine).

xVga.description: Mark as the guest's primary VGA (x-vga=1) — host loses the display while the guest runs.

rombar.description: Make the device ROM visible to the guest (rombar=1).

romfile.description: Path to a dumped GPU vBIOS, relative to /usr/share/kvm (some GPUs need this to reset cleanly).

mdev.description: Mediated-device type for vGPU splitting (rarely applicable to consumer GPUs).

vmSpec.description: Desired state for a Proxmox QEMU/KVM VM. Provisioned by the ProxmoxSharp VM write path (#115) — NOT by the community-scripts (LXC) create path. Only spec.vmid is strictly required; node may be inherited from the owning stack's defaults.

node.description: Target Proxmox node (e.g. 'desktop-01'). Required to deploy; may be inherited from the stack's defaults.

vmid.description: VM ID. REQUIRED — omission is an error (no silent allocation; mirrors LXC ctid). An integer (validated to fall within the owning stack's ctidRange), or the literal 'auto' to draw the next free ID from the stack range.

name.description: VM name (Proxmox 'name'); defaults to metadata.name. Renaming an adopted VM is non-destructive.

machine.description: QEMU machine type, e.g. 'q35' (required for PCIe passthrough) or a pinned 'pc-q35-10.1'.

bios.description: Firmware. 'ovmf' (UEFI) is required for GPU passthrough + Secure Boot; pairs with an efidisk.

cpu.description: CPU model (Proxmox 'cpu'), e.g. 'host' to expose the full host feature set (best for gaming).

numa.description: Enable NUMA topology in the guest.

onboot.description: Start automatically on host boot. Default false for GPU VMs (single GPU → start on demand).

manage.description: Lifecycle stance. 'managed' (default) means converge may create, reconcile and destroy this member. 'describe-only' means the shape DOCUMENTS an adopted guest that predates it: converge reads it and resolves dependsOn against it, but NEVER writes to it — plan shows it as describe-only instead of perpetual drift, apply skips it, and destroy refuses it. Naming it in --only does not override this. Use for guests adopted in place, where the shape can never fully match reality and that difference is intentional. 'retired' means the member has been SUPERSEDED and must not come back: converge never creates or writes it, --only cannot override that, and plan flags it if the guest still exists. A `retired` tag plus a comment does not do this — the engine reads neither, which is how CT 5113 was rebuilt months after retirement (#362). `converge destroy` is still allowed, and is the supported way to clean one up.
manage.$comment: #325 — adopted members were previously protected only by prose in CLAUDE.md plus the operator remembering --only.

scsihw.description: SCSI controller model (e.g. 'virtio-scsi-single' — needed for per-disk iothread).

vga.description: Display adapter (Proxmox 'vga'), e.g. 'none' when a passed-through GPU drives the display, or 'std'/'virtio'.

networks.description: Full multi-NIC list (net0..netN). Use spec.network for the single-NIC sugar.

hostpci.description: PCI(e) passthrough devices (hostpci0..N) — e.g. the GPU. The reconciler should warn if another VM already holds the same device.

pool.description: Proxmox resource pool to place the VM in.

tags.description: Labels (→ Proxmox tags). Mainly used in a Stack's spec.defaults to apply common labels; a member normally uses metadata.tags.

dependsOn.description: Names of shapes that must converge first (converge-only; topological ordering).

config.description: App/guest-specific post-create settings the converge engine applies (e.g. install Sunshine). NOT touched by the create path.

secrets.description: Secrets the converge engine resolves at provision time and feeds to the post-create step. Converge-only.

lxcSpec.description: Desired state for a Proxmox LXC. Only metadata.name + spec.ctid + spec.app are practically needed for the community-scripts create path; everything else has a sane default or is converge-only.

not.$comment: #383 — `network` and `networks` are two spellings of the same net0. Allowing both means the create path reads one and the reconciler rewrites net0 from the other, so every converge bounces the primary link. Declare the single-NIC sugar OR the full list, never both.

node.description: Target Proxmox node (e.g. 'desktop-01'). Required to deploy; may be inherited from the stack's defaults.

app.description: community-scripts slug selecting ct/<app>.sh (e.g. 'forgejo', 'forgejo-runner', 'github-runner', 'docker', 'debian'). Required for the community-scripts create path.

provisioner.description: Post-create provisioner override. The CT is CREATED via 'app' (ct/<app>.sh) but the post-create provisioner is dispatched by 'provisioner' instead — lets a generic Docker host (app: docker) run a rich app provisioner (e.g. 'pangolin'). Defaults to 'app' when omitted.

ctid.description: Container ID. REQUIRED — omission is an error (no silent allocation). Use an integer (the norm; validated to fall within the owning stack's ctidRange), or the literal 'auto' to draw the next free ID from the stack range (the rare, explicit exception).

os.description: Base OS / template distro (→ var_os; Proxmox ostype). e.g. 'debian', 'alpine', 'ubuntu'.

unprivileged.description: Unprivileged container (→ var_unprivileged). Note: NFS/CIFS mounts inside an unprivileged CT need extra capabilities — prefer host-level.

manage.description: Lifecycle stance. 'managed' (default) means converge may create, reconcile and destroy this member. 'describe-only' means the shape DOCUMENTS an adopted guest that predates it: converge reads it and resolves dependsOn against it, but NEVER writes to it — plan shows it as describe-only instead of perpetual drift, apply skips it, and destroy refuses it. Naming it in --only does not override this. Use for guests adopted in place, where the shape can never fully match reality and that difference is intentional. 'retired' means the member has been SUPERSEDED and must not come back: converge never creates or writes it, --only cannot override that, and plan flags it if the guest still exists. A `retired` tag plus a comment does not do this — the engine reads neither, which is how CT 5113 was rebuilt months after retirement (#362). `converge destroy` is still allowed, and is the supported way to clean one up.
manage.$comment: #325 — adopted members were previously protected only by prose in CLAUDE.md plus the operator remembering --only.

storage.description: Proxmox storage for the root volume (→ var_container_storage), e.g. 'local-lvm'.

templateStorage.description: Storage holding the OS template (→ var_template_storage), e.g. 'local'.

networks.description: Full multi-NIC list, index-positional → net0..netN. Mutually exclusive with spec.network (which is the single-NIC sugar for the same net0). Create still provisions ONE interface — net0 is seeded from networks[0] via the community-scripts path, and net1..netN are added by converge's reconcile pass straight after (#383). Reconcile is additive: it adds a missing NIC and corrects a declared key that drifted, but never deletes a netN this list doesn't mention. A NIC with no `hwaddr` keeps the MAC it was created with, so DHCP reservations survive reconcile.

nameserver.description: DNS server IP (→ var_ns). Defaults to host setting.

mounts.description: Storage mounts — post-create / converge (NOT provisioned by community-scripts).

pool.description: Proxmox resource pool to place the CT in.

hookscript.description: Volume path to a lifecycle hook script (e.g. for host-mount ordering).

sshAuthorizedKey.description: Public key to inject (→ var_ssh_authorized_key). Enables var_ssh.

tags.description: Labels merged into metadata.tags (→ var_tags). Mainly used in a Stack's spec.defaults to apply common labels to every member; a member normally uses metadata.tags.

dependsOn.description: Names of shapes that must converge first. Converge-only (BL-010): the engine topologically orders by this, and a dependency's resolved attributes (e.g. URL/IP) become available to this shape's config/secrets.

config.description: App-specific post-create settings the converge engine's provisioner applies (e.g. forgejo { rootUrl }, github-runner { githubOrg }, cloudflared { tunnel, ingress }). NOT touched by the community-scripts create path.

secrets.description: Secrets the converge engine resolves at provision time (from secrets.env, another service, or a provider) and feeds to the post-create step. Converge-only; never provisioned by community-scripts.

stackSpec.description: A stack groups members and owns a CTID range + inheritable defaults. Members reference it via metadata.stack.

ctidRange.description: Reserved CTID block. Explicit member ctids MUST fall within [start,end] (else error); 'ctid: auto' draws the next free ID from here.

defaults.description: Default LXC spec values inherited by members of this stack. Member values override. (Reuses the LXC spec shape; all fields optional here.)
